metrics.definition: Best bid price at each observation instant
metrics.sampling_frequency: Every tick change or 100ms poll minimum during active collection windows
metrics.collection_method: MT5 symbol_info_tick().bid logged on timer + on order send

metrics.definition: Best ask price at each observation instant
metrics.collection_method: MT5 symbol_info_tick().ask

metrics.definition: UTC microsecond timestamp of quote observation
metrics.collection_method: time.time() UTC at poll; MT5 tick.time_msc if available

metrics.definition: ask - bid in price points over time
metrics.collection_method: Computed at ingest: spread = ask - bid
metrics.storage_format: Parquet spread_points float32; agg table spread_1m

metrics.definition: Spread distribution conditional on Asian/London/Overlap/NY
metrics.sampling_frequency: Session tag per tick from UTC hour
metrics.collection_method: Derive session_from_hour at ingest; aggregate p50/p95 per session

metrics.definition: Spread stats Mon–Fri plus Sunday open
metrics.collection_method: Weekday tag on tick; Sunday 22:00–02:00 UTC window flagged

metrics.definition: Spread in T-5min to T-1min before scheduled high-impact events
metrics.collection_method: Economic calendar join; tag ticks pre_event

metrics.definition: Spread T+0 to T+15min post release
metrics.collection_method: Calendar join post_event flag

metrics.definition: Spread 21:55–22:15 UTC daily (broker rollover window)
metrics.collection_method: Time filter flag is_rollover

metrics.definition: fill_price - requested_price (buy positive = worse)
metrics.collection_method: Log requested_price at send; fill_price from order result
metrics.expected_collection_duration: Until 500 fills or 90 days paper/live shadow

metrics.definition: Slippage favorable to trader (price improvement)
metrics.sampling_frequency: Subset of slippage where sign favorable
metrics.collection_method: Classify slippage_sign from signed slippage

metrics.definition: Adverse slippage magnitude distribution
metrics.collection_method: abs(min(0, signed_slippage))

metrics.definition: Slippage on opening deal only
metrics.collection_method: Tag deal entry_in; map to bot entry signals via ticket/time

metrics.definition: Slippage on closing deal vs expected SL/TP/close price
metrics.collection_method: Compare fill to SL/TP level or quote at send

metrics.definition: filled_volume < requested_volume
metrics.collection_method: MT5 deal volume vs request volume

metrics.definition: t_fill - t_send in milliseconds
metrics.collection_method: Monotonic clock at send and on result callback

metrics.definition: Portion of delay attributable to broker (result.time - send approx)
metrics.sampling_frequency: Per order when MT5 result time available
metrics.collection_method: MT5 order/deal time_msc minus local send time (clock sync note)

metrics.definition: RTT estimate via periodic ping or tick arrival jitter
metrics.collection_method: Optional ICMP to broker host; or tick inter-arrival stability

metrics.definition: Send order to confirmation total ms
metrics.collection_method: Same as execution_delay

metrics.definition: MT5 TRADE_RETCODE_* on failed or requoted orders
metrics.collection_method: Log result.retcode result.comment on every send
metrics.storage_format: Orders table retcode int; retcode_stats.json histogram

metrics.definition: Orders rejected when price within freeze_level of market
metrics.sampling_frequency: On reject with retcode related to freeze
metrics.collection_method: symbol_info.freeze_level at reject time; log distance
metrics.required_sample_size: ≥10 events or symbol_info snapshot if none

metrics.definition: SL/TP placement within stops_level minimum distance
metrics.sampling_frequency: On order validate fail or adjust
metrics.collection_method: symbol_info.stops_level logged at each entry with SL/TP distance

metrics.definition: account.margin account.margin_free account.margin_level
metrics.collection_method: MT5 account_info snapshot

metrics.definition: Forced liquidation when margin_level below stop_out
metrics.collection_method: Log if margin_level < stop_out_level; history_deals with comment
metrics.required_sample_size: ≥1 if possible; symbol_info stop_out level required regardless
metrics.calibration_importance: LOW at 0.01 lot; HIGH for realism completeness

metrics.definition: Per-deal commission from account/deal history
metrics.collection_method: MT5 history_deals commission field

metrics.definition: Overnight swap charged per position
metrics.collection_method: history_deals swap field; position swap snapshot 22:00 UTC

metrics.definition: Filled lot size per deal
metrics.collection_method: MT5 deal volume

metrics.definition: Partial fill + requote + off-quotes cluster indicating thin book
metrics.collection_method: Tag cluster events; spread widen simultaneous

metrics.definition: Friday close to Sunday open price jump
metrics.collection_method: Last tick Fri 21:00 UTC vs first tick Sun open

metrics.definition: Exit fill worse than SL by more than tolerance
metrics.collection_method: Compare exit fill to SL level; flag gap_through
metrics.required_sample_size: ≥10 if occurs; model from weekend gaps otherwise

metrics.definition: Exit fill better than TP beyond tolerance
metrics.collection_method: Compare exit fill to TP

metrics.definition: Fill better than quoted ask (buy) or bid (sell) at send
metrics.collection_method: Compare fill to quote at send time
